$description: Volve Solutions design tokens v3.0 (29 Oct 2026). Single source of truth for colour, type, spacing and contact facts. Edit here, then run `node design/scripts/build-tokens.js` to regenerate volve.css. Format follows the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) draft: $value, $type, $description. Derived tints list the resolved hex for tools that cannot do transparency (PDF libraries, image tools).

espresso.$description: Brand colour 1 of 6. Primary dark surface. Primary text on light. The Call Bar.

paper.$description: Brand colour 2 of 6. Primary light surface. Primary text on dark.

white.$description: Brand colour 3 of 6. Cards on paper. Print pages. Never text on paper (no contrast).

slate.$description: Brand colour 4 of 6. Secondary text on light. Small surfaces only (card headers, chips). Never a full background. Never text on espresso (2.9:1 fails).

ochre.$description: Brand colour 5 of 6. Accent on light surfaces at 24px+ only (3.1:1). Primary button fill. Never small text on light.

gold.$description: Brand colour 6 of 6. Accent on dark (8.8:1). Signal surface. Eyebrows on dark. Never text on light (1.9:1 fails).

alert.$description: Functional only. Urgent findings and errors in reports and apps. Never decoration, headings or marketing.

tint.$description: Derived from the six. Not new colours. Use the alpha form in CSS, the resolved hex everywhere else.

line-on-light.$description: Dividers and card borders on paper.

fill-subtle.$description: Quiet fills: table stripes, input backgrounds.

surface.$description: Three surface modes. Pick one per composition.

dark.$description: Default for social and the website hero. Premium, calm, makes photos glow.

light.$description: Default for reports, proposals, documents, email and website body.

signal.$description: Loud mode. Max 1 in 4 social posts. Never reports or documents.

status.$description: Report and app finding states. Always label + colour, never colour alone.

display.$value: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
display.$description: Headlines, display numbers, accent phrases (italic). Weight 400 only. Never body text, never under 22px.

type.$description: Type scales by medium. Sizes in px except print (pt). lh = line-height, ls = letter-spacing.

social-1080.$description: Facebook canvases (1080 wide). Floor: nothing under 30px. A 1080 post shows at about 0.36x on a phone.

display.use: Type-led and Signal headlines, 2 to 4 words per line

card-title.use: Rows inside product and paper cards

eyebrow.use: Call Bar offer line, card headers

phone.use: The Call Bar number. Fit to the margin, never wider

small.use: Call Bar footer line and URL

wordmark.use: Lockup height (symbol) in the top-left slot

screen-390.$description: Phone-first web report, website and app. Floor: 16px body, 12px labels.

desktop-multiplier.use: Display, h1 and h2 scale up by this at 1024px+. Body stays 17 to 18px.

print-a4.$description: A4 PDFs (reports, proposals, flyers). Sizes in pt. Floor: 9pt.

screen-measure.$description: Max reading width for body text.

social-margin.$description: Safe margin on 1080 canvases, all sides.

story-safe-top.$description: 9:16 top zone kept clear of text (profile and progress bar).

story-safe-bottom.$description: 9:16 bottom zone kept clear of text except the Call Bar footer line (reply bar).

card-on-dark.$description: Paper props and product cards on espresso.

fade-depth.$description: Photo band fades into espresso over this share of its height, top and bottom. The only gradient allowed anywhere.

grade.$value: warm, low-key, single warm light source, blacks lifted to espresso not pure black

contact.$description: Brand facts. Templates read these, so a number change is a one-line edit.

phone-business-check.$description: Business Check line TODAY. From about 10 Nov 2026 change to display '1300 244 769', tel '1300244769' (Twilio port) and re-render posts.

phone-volverighto.$description: VolveRighto AI receptionist demo line once the 1300 port completes.

offer.$description: Customer-facing offer name. Internal name: AI Business Audit.
